purpose: Test whether an identity-free return forecast and a separate downside forecast can be translated by a deterministic state policy and a training-only scenario risk constraint into coherent after-cost paper decisions.
decision_question: Do general market-relative patterns improve after-cost return and drawdown when prediction, downside estimation, state transitions, and portfolio constraints are evaluated as separate components?

governance.blind_evidence_source: Predictions locked prospectively after the complete v3 implementation and readiness audit

entry_dependencies.if_dependencies_fail: Stop before model fitting and report a data-lineage failure.

information_timing.decision_time: After the adjusted close of decision date t
information_timing.execution_time: Next-session adjusted open when trustworthy; otherwise an explicitly labeled next-session-close proxy

return_head.name: future_residual_return_5d
return_head.definition: Security five-trading-day return minus the same-date eligible-universe equal-weight five-trading-day return
return_head.model_objective: Predict continuous residual return and preserve cross-sectional ranking
return_head.outlier_policy: Winsorization bounds, if used, are learned from training rows only

downside_head.name: future_residual_bottom_quintile_5d
downside_head.definition: One when the security is in the same-date bottom 20 percent of eligible-universe residual returns
downside_head.model_objective: Calibrated probability of material market-relative downside
downside_head.threshold_timing: The bottom-quintile boundary is calculated within each outcome date and never from future dates

ann_challenger.loss: Training-fold-scaled Huber return loss plus binary cross-entropy downside loss with equal initial head weights
ann_challenger.role: Nonlinear challenger; it must beat the linear control without worse risk

state_policy.principle: Models estimate return and downside; deterministic rules translate estimates into actions.
state_policy.enter: Eligible non-held security may enter only when predicted residual return exceeds estimated round-trip cost plus the training-fitted entry margin, downside probability is below its training-fitted ceiling, and the scenario gate passes.
state_policy.hold: Existing position remains held when predicted net residual return stays positive, downside probability remains below the exit ceiling, and no confirmed deterioration exit fires.
state_policy.exit: Exit when predicted net residual return is nonpositive, downside probability breaches its training-fitted exit ceiling, eligibility is lost, or confirmed deterioration fires.
state_policy.avoid: Remain in cash for otherwise eligible securities that fail an entry condition.
state_policy.confirmed_deterioration: Observed drawdown pressure must coincide with momentum deterioration or volatility expansion. A price decline alone never forces a sale.
state_policy.threshold_policy: All numeric score, downside, and deterioration thresholds are estimated inside each training fold from prespecified training quantiles, then frozen for its validation period. No validation or prospective outcome may choose a threshold.
state_policy.hysteresis: The training-fitted exit ceiling must be weaker than the entry ceiling so ordinary noise does not create immediate sell-and-rebuy churn.

scenario_constraint.method: Training-only date-block bootstrap preserving common-market shocks, with residuals conditioned on broad market regime and volatility state only when each cell has adequate training support
scenario_constraint.fallback: Use the unconditional training residual distribution when a regime cell lacks support
uses: Reject entries with nonpositive expected net residual return after costs
Reject entries whose downside tail exceeds the training-fitted risk budget
Reduce exposure or hold cash when portfolio tail risk exceeds the frozen budget
prohibited_uses: Creating zero-trade behavior without reporting feasibility failure
scenario_constraint.feasibility_gate: On training-only simulation, the frozen constraint must admit at least 5 percent and no more than 40 percent of otherwise eligible entry dates; otherwise stop and label the scenario policy infeasible before validation.

portfolio.position_priority: Highest predicted net residual return among securities passing every entry constraint

historical_validation.inner_loop_scope: Fit preprocessing, loss scaling, calibration, and prespecified quantile thresholds using training dates only
historical_validation.outer_loop_scope: Evaluate the completely frozen fold policy
historical_validation.overlapping_label_control: Primary economic inference uses non-overlapping five-day cohorts; daily overlapping results are descriptive
placebos: random eligible portfolio with identical position and turnover constraints
historical_validation.multiple_testing_policy: Only the fixed linear control and fixed ANN challenger are compared; no replacement arm may be selected from outer-fold results.

prospective_confirmation.start: First trading date after implementation, lineage audit, model freeze, and readiness hash

prediction: downside Brier score and base-rate Brier
portfolio: net total return at 10, 25, and 50 bps

pass_fail.failure_action: Record the failure. Do not retune on outer folds or prospective outcomes and do not search for a replacement using the same confirmation data.
pass_fail.passing_action: Record research evidence only. No trading or automatic promotion.

implementation_sequence: Complete and audit point-in-time historical-universe reconstruction.
Materialize feature and globally defined target panels before universe filtering.
Implement the linear control, fixed ANN challenger, state engine, T+1 ledger, and scenario constraint.
Run leakage, identity, duplicate, alias, stale-price, delisting, settlement, and cost unit tests.
Register the exact design in context_gate.json and pass the duplicate/design-signature gate.
Run nested historical walk-forward once and report all arms and failures.
Freeze one unchanged prospective policy only if historical quality gates pass.
Hash predictions and portfolios before attaching every prospective outcome.
Evaluate prospectively only after the minimum sample is complete.
explicit_non_goals: Recovering losses by selling every falling security
Selecting rules from explanatory 3D or 4D diagrams
Treating Monte Carlo paths as forecasts
